Renaissance Technologies
Released its Q3 2026 13F (holdings report)‼️
The world’s top-tier quant fund, founded by mathematician Jim Simons🧮
A systematic strategy that trades using mathematical and statistical models📊
Sold off more than 99% of its Nvidia and Meta holdings📉
Increased its Micron position nearly sevenfold and made a new investment in SpaceX🚀

🔸13F Overview
✔️As-of date: September 30, 2026
📈Number of holdings: 3,151 (3,140 in the previous quarter)
📈Total holdings value: $73.42 billion (+1.1% Q/Q)
✔️Note that the increase in total holdings value does not reflect investment returns

🔸Top 10 Holdings ※Percentages in parentheses
1️⃣Micron Technology $MU : $1.62 billion (2.2%) — increased position
2️⃣Advanced Micro Devices $AMD : $1.21 billion (1.6%) — increased position
3️⃣United Therapeutics $UTHR : $910 million (1.2%) — partial sale
4️⃣Intel $INTC : $830 million (1.1%) — partial sale
5️⃣Alphabet $GOOGL : $830 million (1.1%) — increased position
6️⃣UnitedHealth Group $UNH : $820 million (1.1%) — increased position
7️⃣Exelixis $EXEL : $750 million (1.0%) — partial sale
8️⃣VeriSign $VRSN : $650 million (0.9%) — partial sale
9️⃣SpaceX $SPCX : $620 million (0.8%) — new position
🔟Corcept Therapeutics $CORT : $560 million (0.8%) — partial sale

🔸Major Position Increases
📈Micron Technology $MU : +619%, 1.52 million shares ($1.62 billion)
📈Advanced Micro Devices $AMD : +140%, approximately 2 million shares ($1.21 billion)
📈Seagate Technology $STX : $500 million
📈Sandisk $SNDK : $480 million

🔸New Purchases
📈SpaceX $SPCX : 4.11 million shares ($620 million)
📈Bank of America $BAC : $350 million
📈Goldman Sachs $GS : $240 million

🔸Major Sales
📉Nvidia $NVDA : 7.09 million shares → 23,000 shares (-99.7%)
✔️It was the largest holding at $1.42 billion as of Q2
📉Meta Platforms $META : 2.02 million shares → 1,577 shares (-99%+)
📉Also sold off nearly all of its Apple $AAPL and Amazon $AMZN holdings

🔸Summary
✔️Of Nvidia, Meta, and Intel, which were the top three in Q2, it sold off nearly all of its Nvidia and Meta holdings
✔️In AI-related investments, funds shifted from GPUs and platforms to memory (Micron, Sandisk, Seagate) and AMD
✔️The holdings are primarily in funds for institutional investors (RIEF, RIDA, RIDGE), so the Medallion Fund’s well-known short-term trading is largely not reflected

result.text:
$FPS Bank of America reiterates buy and maintains their $68 price target noting:

"Forgent Power Solutions, a manufacturer of electrical distribution equipment, reported 1QF27 (September-end) revenue 3.9% above consensus and adjusted EBITDA 7.1% above consensus. That said, the company had already pre-announced >$465mn revenue and >$100mn adjusted EBITDA on Oct. 22. In conjunction with last quarter’s results, management announced it would no longer be disclosing quarter orders or backlog. However, deferred revenue (i.e., down payments) increased 60% q/q and this sequential increase was greater than last quarter (when the company had $1.5bn in orders). CEO Niederpruem commented that FPS has a backlog that fully covers F27 guidance and continues to make progress with multiple artificial intelligence (AI) labs and hyperscalers. The midpoint of FY27 adjusted EBITDA guidance was increased $12mn; this was more than 1QF27’s $10mn beat versus the midpoint of guidance. New midpoint of $612mn compares to $613mn consensus. We reiterate our Buy rating and $68 price objective."
